zh.title: 加拿大航空開闢A321XLR倫敦希斯路線 早班機配合多倫多聯運美境預檢
zh.summary: 加拿大航空啟航A321XLR飛希斯路線；早班機抵倫敦晚間、經多倫多享美境預檢
body: 根據Simple Flying報導，加拿大航空已啟用空中巴士A321XLR執飛倫敦希斯路線，飛行時間約8小時，這是該機型在跨大西洋市場的最新商業部署里程碑。
報導指出，航班採早班機起飛安排，可於晚間抵達倫敦，並透過多倫多樞紐聯運提供美國境外預檢服務，讓轉機乘客在加拿大完成美國入境手續後以國內航班身分抵達美國。
報導標題雖提及「但有一個轉折」，但摘要中未說明具體內容，完整細節有待完整報導披露。

en.title: Air Canada Launches A321XLR Heathrow Route with Early Departures and US Preclearance via Toronto
en.summary: Air Canada launches A321XLR Heathrow service; early departures arrive London evening with US preclearance via Toronto
body: According to Simple Flying, Air Canada has launched Airbus A321XLR service on the London Heathrow route with a flight time of approximately 8 hours, marking the type's latest commercial deployment across the Atlantic.

The report states that flights operate with early morning departures arriving in London in the evening, and offer US preclearance via Toronto hub connections, allowing connecting passengers to complete US entry formalities in Canada before arriving as domestic passengers.
The headline mentions a twist but the summary does not disclose details; full particulars await the complete article.

zh.title: 美空軍預算文件顯示戰機飛行員編制於2027年將降至67%
zh.summary: 美空軍預算預測戰機飛行員編制2027年降至67%；目前人數低於目標三分之一。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，美國空軍最新的預算文件指出，戰鬥機飛行員的編制員額預計將在 2027 年進一步下降，屆時僅能達到預定目標的 67%。這項數據突顯出美軍戰術航空部隊所面臨的人力缺口。
預算文件分析顯示，由於飛行員配備比例持續下滑，美國空軍的戰鬥機飛行員社群正承受日益嚴重的營運壓力。目前戰機飛行員的實際人力已低於預定目標的三分之一，反映出軍方在維持飛行人員數量方面面臨嚴峻考驗。
此項人力短缺情況直接影響到空軍戰鬥機部隊的勤務調派與整體運作。預算文件所列出的未來趨勢表明，若人力狀況未能改善，戰機飛行員編制不足的問題將在 2027 年達到降至 67% 的預測水準。

en.title: US Air Force Budget Documents Project Fighter Aviator Manning Will Fall To 67% In 2027
en.summary: US Air Force budget documents project fighter aviator manning will drop to 67 percent in 2027.
body: According to Simple Flying, recent US Air Force budget documents indicate that fighter aviator manning levels are projected to drop to 67 percent of target capacity by 2027. The projection highlights ongoing staffing challenges within the service's tactical aviation force.

The documents reveal that the US Air Force fighter jet community is under increasing operational strain due to declining staffing levels. Manning for fighter pilots currently stands at one-third below required targets, pointing to persistent personnel issues.

This shortfall continues to impact operational readiness across fighter units. If current staffing trends persist, budget forecasts show that fighter aviator staffing will reach the projected 67 percent level in 2027.

zh.title: 美國航空業擴大高端艙等布局優質旅客
zh.summary: 捷藍推BlueFirst；美航777增144優質座位；西南航空設首間貴賓室
body: 美國主要航空公司近日密集發布高端艙等擴充計畫，顯示業者聚焦高付費旅客以謀求營收增長。捷藍航空於9月1日發表國內線頭等艙產品BlueFirst，美國航空翌日公開重度高端化配置的波音777-300ER，西南航空隨後宣布將設立首間機場貴賓室。
捷藍航空BlueFirst安排雙邊通道各兩座，較標準Main艙座多達7吋腿部空間，配備13.3吋螢幕、藍牙連線、電源插座及升級餐飲服務。首席執行官Geraghty表示：「旅客越來越尋求更高端的體驗。」BlueFirst定位介於EvenMore加大空間座位與全平躺Mint艙之間，提供多價位選擇。
美國航空新改裝777-300ER擁有70個具隱私門的Flagship Suite商務艙、44個豪華經濟艙與30個Main Cabin Extra座位，共144個高端或加大空間座位。公司稱此機型商務與豪華經濟艙座位數超越所有美籍航空公司同類機隊。
美國航空並將於11月19日起停售該機型Flagship First國際頭等艙，專注擴大商務艙規模。窄體機隊方面，公司8月宣稱高端座位佔比約25%，計畫透過換裝與新機交付提升至約40%。空中巴士A319、A320將增設頭等艙座位，未來波音737 MAX 10將配置24個頭等艙座位。
美國航空預期國際線全平躺座位將於本十年末增加逾50%。西南航空宣布首度進軍貴賓室市場，標誌該低成本航空商業模式轉向。多家業者同步投入數十億美元建置貴賓室、機上娛樂、Wi-Fi等高端旅程要素，傳統經濟艙佔比恐進一步縮減。
航空業觀察人士指出，三大不同商業模式的航空公司同步加碼高端產品，反映疫後高價位旅客需求強勁，且業者認為優質艙等為未來營收增長關鍵引擎。

en.title: US airlines expand premium cabins targeting high-spending travelers
en.summary: JetBlue launches BlueFirst domestic first class; American adds 144 premium seats on 777-300ER; Southwest plans first lounges
body: Major US airlines announced a cluster of premium-cabin expansions this week, signalling a shared strategy of chasing higher-spending passengers for revenue growth. On September 1, JetBlue Airways unveiled BlueFirst, its new domestic first-class product. The following day, American Airlines revealed a heavily premium-configured Boeing 777-300ER with 144 upgraded seats. Hours later, Southwest Airlines disclosed plans for its first-ever airport lounges.

JetBlue's BlueFirst seats are arranged two abreast on each side of the aisle, providing up to seven inches more legroom than standard Main seats. They feature 13.3-inch screens, Bluetooth connectivity, power outlets, and upgraded food, drinks and amenities. Chief executive Joanna Geraghty said: "Customers are increasingly looking for more premium experiences." BlueFirst sits above the EvenMore extra-legroom product and below the lie-flat Mint cabin, giving the carrier multiple price points for extra space.

American's retrofitted 777-300ER carries 70 Flagship Suite business-class seats with privacy doors, 44 Premium Economy seats, and 30 Main Cabin Extra seats, totalling 144 seats the airline categorises as premium or extra-legroom. American states this gives the aircraft more business and premium economy seats than any aircraft operated by a US carrier.

The carrier will stop selling Flagship First international first class on the 777-300ER for travel from November 19, concentrating instead on a larger business-class cabin. On narrowbodies, American said in August that premium seating represents about 25% of seats today, with a target of roughly 40% through deliveries and retrofits. Airbus A319 and A320 aircraft are gaining additional first-class seats, while future Boeing 737 MAX 10s will have 24 first-class seats. American expects lie-flat seats on its international fleet to increase by more than 50% by the end of the decade.

Southwest's lounge announcement marks a notable shift for the low-cost carrier. Across the industry, carriers are investing billions in lounges, inflight entertainment, Wi-Fi and other premium-journey elements, which may progressively shrink the traditional economy cabin's share of aircraft real estate.

Industry observers note that three airlines with very different histories and business models moving in the same direction reflects strong post-pandemic demand for higher-fare travel and a belief that premium cabins are a key engine for future revenue growth.

zh.title: 越竹航空僅餘一架A321營運，持續包機服務
zh.summary: 越竹航空機隊縮減至一架A321；持續營運包機航線
body: 越南航空公司越竹航空（Bamboo Airways）的營運機隊已縮減至僅剩一架空中巴士A321（ICAO機型代碼A321），但根據《Aerospace Global News》報導，該公司仍持續營運。
報導指出，這架註冊編號VN-A227的A321-200近期主要用於包機服務，包括峴港至澳門之間的航線。航班追蹤資料顯示，該機在9月3日仍持續營運此航線。
越竹航空原本擁有44架飛機，近年逐步縮減營運規模，至8月起已暫停河內至胡志明市、河內至峴港等主要國內航線的定期航班售票。
僅有一架飛機使越竹航空缺乏備援，一旦發生技術缺陷或定期維修，營運將受到影響。公司可能透過濕租方式取得暫時的運能替代。

en.title: Bamboo Airways operates with single Airbus A321; charter flights continue
en.summary: Bamboo Airways fleet reduced to one Airbus A321; continues charter operations
body: Bamboo Airways, a Vietnamese airline, has reduced its operational fleet to a single Airbus A321 (ICAO type code A321), but the carrier remains in operation, according to an article by Aerospace Global News.

The sole active aircraft, an Airbus A321-200 registered VN-A227, has recently been used primarily on charter operations, including between Da Nang and Macau. Flight tracking data shows the aircraft operating the route as recently as 3 September.

Bamboo Airways previously operated a fleet of 44 aircraft but has spent several years scaling back. By August, it had suspended scheduled flight sales on key domestic routes including Hanoi–Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi–Da Nang.
With only one aircraft, the airline has no spare capacity to manage technical defects or routine maintenance, though wet leasing could provide a temporary replacement.
